SELECT base.id, base.order_code, base.customer_code, base.customer_name, base.order_type, base.order_state, base.change_type, base.remark, SUM(details.deliver_num) as orderNum, ROUND((SUM(details.deliver_num) - SUM(details.delivered_num)),2) as un_deliver_num, currentDetail.deliver_time as min_deliver_time FROM oms_order_base_review as base INNER JOIN oms_order_details_review as details ON base.order_code = details.order_code INNER JOIN ( SELECT tab.order_code, tab.deliver_time FROM ( SELECT details.order_code, details.deliver_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_code ORDER BY ABS(details.deliver_time - CURRENT_DATE) ASC) AS rn FROM oms_order_details_review as details where 1 = 1 ) as tab WHERE rn= 1 ) as currentDetail ON base.order_code = currentDetail.order_code
AND base.del_flag = '0'
AND base.order_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.orderCode},'%')
AND base.customer_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.customerCode},'%')
AND base.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.customerName},'%')
AND base.order_state = #{query.orderState}
AND base.factory_code = #{query.factoryCode}
GROUP BY base.id, base.order_code, currentDetail.deliver_time ORDER BY base.create_time DESC

SELECT base.order_code, base.order_state FROM oms_order_base_review as base INNER JOIN oms_order_details_review as details ON base.order_code = details.order_code INNER JOIN ( SELECT tab.order_code, tab.deliver_time FROM ( SELECT details.order_code, details.deliver_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_code ORDER BY ABS(details.deliver_time - CURRENT_DATE) ASC) AS rn FROM oms_order_details_review as details where 1 = 1 ) as tab WHERE rn= 1 ) as currentDetail ON base.order_code = currentDetail.order_code
AND base.del_flag = '0'
AND base.order_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.orderCode},'%')
AND base.customer_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.customerCode},'%')
AND base.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.customerName},'%')
AND base.factory_code = #{query.factoryCode}
GROUP BY base.order_code, base.order_state
